other_failure_modes.name: Combinatorial Feature Explosion
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates interaction features (e.g., ratios, differences, groupby aggregations) using nested loops over all numerical and categorical columns without any feature selection or limit. This leads to a massive number of features (O(N^2)), causing the script to run out of memory or time out during model training.

summary: The agent implements a highly robust and sophisticated data science pipeline, featuring correct out-of-fold target encoding, multiple model types with both log and raw targets, and a well-formulated SLSQP ensemble. However, it blindly generates pairwise interactions and aggregations for all numerical and categorical columns, leading to a combinatorial feature explosion that causes the script to time out. Additionally, it only evaluates the final ensemble using a single metric (RMSE).
